T.description: Number of weeks in the planning horizon

K.description: Number of promotional price levels excluding the regular price

M.description: Number of lagged prices used in the demand model

L.description: Maximum number of promotion weeks allowed in the horizon

S.description: Required number of separating periods between promotions

q_k.description: Allowed price ladder where q_0 is the regular price and q_1 to q_3 are promotional prices

c_t.description: Unit procurement cost in each week

eta_current.description: Exponent on current price in the demand model

eta_lag1.description: Exponent on previous week's price in the demand model

eta_lag2.description: Exponent on price from two weeks ago in the demand model

p_init.description: Fixed pre-horizon prices used for lagged demand terms

gamma_t_k.description: Binary variable equal to 1 if price level k is selected in week t, and 0 otherwise

p_t.description: Selling price in week t determined by the selected price level

d_t.description: Demand in week t determined by the nonlinear demand function

constraints.expression: p_t = sum_{k=0}^{3} q_k[k] * gamma_t_k[t,k] for all t = 1,...,13
d_t = a_t[t] * p_t^(eta_current) * p_{t-1}^(eta_lag1) * p_{t-2}^(eta_lag2) for all t = 1,...,13, with p_0 = 3.49 and p_-1 = 3.49
sum_{tau=t}^{t+2} sum_{k=1}^{3} gamma_t_k[tau,k] <= 1 for all t = 1,...,11
gamma_t_k[t,k] in {0,1} for all t = 1,...,13 and k = 0,1,2,3
